No Glenroy job is on the public record. That is a gap in what we can prove about Glenroy rather than a gap in where we take gutters.

Fascia

What a clean finds underneath

A gutter clean in Glenroy often comes back with news about the fascia, and it is worth knowing why those two are connected.

Wet material against timber

Organic matter in a gutter holds water against whatever the gutter is fixed to. On timber fascia that is rot. On a steel gutter it is corrosion, working from the inside where nobody looks.

Neither is a cleaning problem by the time it is visible. Both are the reason the clearing was worth doing earlier.

What else is up there

Nests, balls and roof screws

Not everything in a Glenroy gutter arrived on the wind. A reasonable share of what we pull out was put there deliberately.

Nests, and what they do

A nest in a gutter or behind a downpipe dams it completely rather than partially, and it tends to appear in spring, which is exactly when nobody is thinking about gutters.

Active nests are left alone and reported. There is no version of this job that involves clearing a nest with birds in it.
